description: This Java class defines the configuration parameters for tenant profiles in the Thingsboard platform, including limits on devices, assets, messaging rates, and other tenant-specific settings.

classes.name: DefaultTenantProfileConfiguration
classes.description: A Java class implementing tenant profile configuration with various limits and rate limits for tenant features.

methods.name: getProfileThreshold
methods.description: Returns the threshold value for a specific API usage record key.

methods.name: getProfileFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is enabled based on the profile settings.

methods.name: getWarnThreshold
methods.description: Calculates the warning threshold for a specific API usage record key.

methods.name: getEntitiesLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed entities for a given entity type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the profile type, which is DEFAULT.

methods.name: getMaxRuleNodeExecsPerMessage
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of rule node executions per message.

methods.name: getCfReevaluationCheckInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for CF reevaluation, defaulting to 60 if set to zero or negative.

methods.name: getAlarmsReevaluationInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for alarms reevaluation, defaulting to 60 if set to zero or negative.

methods.name: getIntermediateAggregationIntervalInSecForCF
methods.description: Returns the interval for intermediate aggregation in seconds, defaulting to 300 if set to zero or negative.
